parts.title: Every place in Settings
parts.text:
Settings › Clip making › Clips (/settings/clip-making/clips): How many clips, how long a video can be, and which AI makes them.
  - How many clips (#clip-count): Clip Factory makes between your fewest and most clips each time.
  - Longest video (#longest-video): For a longer video, only the first part is used.
  - AI model (#ai-model): The AI that finds your moments and writes your captions. Your pick is used for your next clips.
Settings › Clip making › Skills (/settings/clip-making/skills): Teach Clip Factory how you like your clips.
  - Your skills (#your-skills): Clip Factory uses every skill here, every time it makes or checks anything.
  - Add a skill (#add-skill): Write one by answering three easy questions, or upload a skill file from your computer.
Settings › Clip making › What it learned (/settings/clip-making/learned): Lessons from your clips that did best.
  - What it learned (#what-it-learned): Lessons from clips that did much better than normal. Turn one off or delete it.
Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow (/settings/clip-making/streamers): Follow YouTube, Twitch and Kick streamers and see who is live.
  - Follow a streamer (#follow-streamer): Paste their link or type their name. Only follow streamers who said you can make clips.
  - Who you follow (#streamers-followed): Who is live right now, and when a stream ended or a new video came out.
  - Clips by itself (#clips-by-itself): Each video it makes costs the same as one you paste. Coming in the next update.
  - Twitch and Kick keys (#streamer-keys): A grown-up does this once. YouTube works without it.
Settings › Clip making › YouTube help (/settings/clip-making/youtube): For when YouTube blocks a video.
  - YouTube cookies (#youtube-cookies): You can skip this. Add them only if YouTube blocks a video. Export them from a private window, then close it.
Settings › Posting › Set up posting (/settings/posting/setup): Connect YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X.
  - Set up posting (#setup-posting): Do each one once. After that Clip Factory posts by itself.
  - The setup list on your screen (#setup-todo): It stays at the top right until each place is set up or skipped. Skipped ones wait here.
  - Who can see your YouTube clips (#youtube-privacy): Everyone, only people with the link, or only you.
  - What X costs (#x-cost): About 1.5 cents a post. It stops at $10 a month.
Settings › Posting › Where clips go (/settings/posting/where): Pick the places your clips go.
  - Upload clips to (#post-to): Pick at least one place.
Settings › Posting › My settings (/settings/posting/my-settings): How each clip goes up: public, open for comments, never made for kids.
  - YouTube (#my-settings-youtube): Everyone can see it, Gaming, tells your subscribers. Never made for kids.
  - TikTok (#my-settings-tiktok): Everyone can see it; comments, Duet and Stitch on. You still tap Use my settings on each clip.
  - Instagram (#my-settings-instagram): Reels also show in your feed.
  - Facebook (#my-settings-facebook): Reels on your Page are public. Nothing to pick.
  - X (#my-settings-x): Everyone can reply. Used once X is set up.
Settings › Posting › Money (/settings/posting/money): How close you are to getting paid, and real money each app reports.
  - Money dashboard (#money-dashboard): The money each app reported, and what each clip earned.
  - Your country (#money-country): Some apps have different goals in each country. Pick yours once.
  - YouTube (#money-youtube): How close you are to the Partner Program, and what YouTube says you earned.
  - TikTok (#money-tiktok): How close you are to Creator Rewards.
  - Instagram (#money-instagram): Followers against the goal for Gifts.
  - Facebook (#money-facebook): Followers, minutes watched and Meta's estimate once it is checked.
  - X (#money-x): Premium and verified followers against the goal.
  - Getting your money out (#money-payouts): Each app pays you itself. Add your bank or PayPal inside each app.
Settings › Look & feel › Sounds (/settings/look-and-feel/sounds): Turn sounds on or off, and pick your two sounds.
  - Sounds (#sounds-on): Sounds only play when you tap, never when you scroll.
  - Click sound (#click-sound): Plays when you tap something that works.
  - Error sound (#error-sound): Plays when something can't be done.
  - Try it (#try-sounds): Hear your two sounds on a pretend Sign in button.
Settings › Look & feel › Motion (/settings/look-and-feel/motion): Less moving around on the screen.
  - Reduce motion (#reduce-motion): Turns off confetti, page moves and the moving background.
Settings › Look & feel › Background (/settings/look-and-feel/background): See-through glass, your picture or your colours.
  - What's behind the glass (#background-kind): Pick See-through, Picture or Colours.
  - Glass strength (#glass-strength): Clear shows more of what's behind. Frosted shows less.
  - Background picture (#background-picture): Use your own picture behind the glass. It stays on this device.
  - Background colours (#background-colours): Mix up to 3 colours behind the glass.
Settings › App & account › Get the app (/settings/app/get-the-app): Open Clip Factory like any other app.
  - Get the app (#get-app): Put Clip Factory on this device, next to your other apps.
Settings › App & account › Notifications (/settings/app/notifications): Get told when your clips are ready, even with the app closed.
  - This device (#notify-device): Turn notifications on here. On iPhone, open Clip Factory from your Home Screen first.
  - Clips ready (#notify-ready): When your clips are done.
  - It stopped (#notify-stopped): When a video stops and needs Try again.
  - Picked up again (#notify-resumed): When a video that stopped starts again by itself.
  - Every step (#notify-steps): One card per video that changes as it works: the step and the clip. It can buzz often.
  - Number on the app icon (#notify-badge): Shows how many videos are working right now.
  - Lock Screen widget (#notify-lock-screen): Lock Screen widgets only come with App Store apps. Your notifications show there instead.
  - Send a test (#notify-test): Sends one to this device so you can see it work.
Settings › App & account › Updates (/settings/app/updates): Your version, and checking for a new one.
  - This version (#this-version): New versions arrive by themselves.
  - Check for updates (#check-updates): Looks for a new version right now.
Settings › App & account › Ask (/settings/app/ask): Web search, and what Ask can do for you.
  - Web search (#ask-web-setup): Lets Ask read today's web pages, for steps that change.
  - What Ask can do (#ask-status): Ask answers any question, knows your app and reads your files.
Settings › App & account › Account (/settings/app/account): Who is signed in, and signing out.
  - Signed in as (#signed-in): The email you use to sign in.
  - Sign out (#sign-out): Signs you out of Clip Factory here.

youtube.title: Have a YouTube channel
say: Open your YouTube account page.
No channel yet? Tap your profile picture, then **Create a channel**.
Shorts are tall videos up to 3 minutes long.
Keep clips with music under 1 minute. Longer ones with music get blocked.

youtube.title: Use a computer
say: The developer websites work best on a computer.
Use the same browser for every step.
Sign in to Google with the account that owns your channel.

youtube.title: Open Google Cloud
say: Open Google Cloud.
First time here? Pick your country, tick the box, press **Agree and continue**.
You do not need a card. Skip any free trial offer.

youtube.title: Make a project
say: Open the new project page.
Project name: paste the name below. Location: **No organization**.
Press **Create**. Wait for the bell at the top to say it is done.
Check that **Clip Factory** is picked at the top of the page.

youtube.title: Turn on YouTube Data API v3
say: Open the YouTube Data API v3 page.
Press **Enable**.

ifYouSee.do: It is already on. Press I did this.

youtube.title: Turn on YouTube Analytics API
say: Open the YouTube Analytics API page.
Press **Enable**.

ifYouSee.do: It is already on. Press I did this.

youtube.title: Start Google Auth Platform
say: Press **Get started**. App name: paste it. Support email: pick yours. Press **Next**.
Audience: pick **External**. Press **Next**.
Contact email: paste it. Press **Next**.
Tick the User Data Policy box. Press **Continue**, then **Create**.

youtube.title: Fill in Branding
say: Paste the three links into the three **App domain** boxes.
Press **Add domain** twice. Paste one domain in each box.
Developer contact: paste your email. Leave the logo empty.
Press **Save**.

ifYouSee.do: If Google will not take a domain, tell Clip Factory support. A custom domain fixes it.

youtube.title: Add the 3 permissions
say: Press **Add or remove scopes**. Scroll down to **Manually add scopes**.
Paste the 3 permissions below. Press **Add to table**.
Press **Update**, then **Save**.

ifYouSee.do: That is normal. Keep going.

youtube.title: Publish the app
say: Press **Publish app**, then confirm.
It must say **In production**. In **Testing**, YouTube stops after 7 days.
Do NOT press **Prepare for verification**.

youtube.title: Make the key
say: Press **Create client**. Application type: **Web application**. Name: paste it.
Under **Authorized redirect URIs** press **Add URI**. Paste the return address.
Press **Create**.
Copy BOTH values now, or press **Download JSON**. Google shows the secret only once.

youtube.title: Paste the key here
say: Paste the **Client ID** and the **Client secret** below.
Or drop the key file Google gave you here: both boxes fill in.
Press **Save keys**.

ifYouSee.do: Open the client, press **Add secret**, use the new one, then **Disable** the old one.

youtube.title: Connect YouTube
say: Press **Connect YouTube**. Pick your account, then your channel.
Google says it has not verified this app? Press **Advanced**, then **Go to … (unsafe)**.
Tick every box (or **Select all**). Press **Continue**.

ifYouSee.see: a web address instead of the app name
ifYouSee.do: That is normal for your own app. Keep going.
Wait 5 minutes and press Connect again. Still wrong? Redo the Make the key step with the Copy button.

youtube.title: Pick who can see your clips
say: Pick who can see new clips on YouTube.
You can change it any time.

youtube.title: Post at least every 6 months
say: Google deletes keys that are not used for 6 months.
It emails you 30 days before. Pressing Connect again keeps them alive.

youtube.title: Only if you post over 100 a day
say: You do not need this to start.
Posting more than 100 clips a day? Fill in Google's form.

tiktok.title: Have your TikTok account
say: Use the TikTok account your clips go on.
Know its login. You will log in a few times.

tiktok.title: Use a computer
say: The developer websites work best on a computer.
Use the same browser for every step.

tiktok.title: Make your TikTok private for now
say: In the TikTok app, tap **Profile**, then the menu (three lines).
Tap **Settings and privacy**, then **Privacy**.
Turn on **Private account**.
Until TikTok checks the app, it only posts to private accounts.

tiktok.title: Make a TikTok developer account
say: Open TikTok for Developers.
Press **Sign up** (or **Log in**). Accept the terms.

tiktok.title: Make an organization
say: Press **Add organization**.
Name: paste it. Press **Create**.

tiktok.title: Create the app
say: Tap your profile icon, then **Manage apps**.
Press **Connect an app**.
Pick your organization. Press **Confirm**.

tiktok.title: Fill in App details
say: Download the icon below, then upload it as the app icon.
Paste the App name and the Description. Category: pick the one that fits best.
Paste the **Terms of Service URL** and the **Privacy Policy URL**.
Don't press **Save** yet. It stays off until **App review** has its text and a video (step 13).

tiktok.title: Choose Web
say: Under **Platforms**, tick **Web** only. Not **Desktop**, not Android or iOS.
Website URL: paste it.

tiktok.title: Add 2 products
say: Press **Add products**.
Add **Login Kit** and **Content Posting API**. Nothing else.
There is no **Display API** to add now. Its permissions come with Login Kit.

tiktok.title: Paste the return address
say: Open the **Login Kit** settings.
Paste the return address into **Redirect URI** for **Web**.

tiktok.title: Turn on Direct Post
say: Open the **Content Posting API** settings.
Turn on **Direct Post**.

ifYouSee.see: a switch with "Direct Post" in its name
ifYouSee.do: Turn that one on.

tiktok.title: Add 2 permissions
say: In **Login Kit**, open **Scopes**. Press **Add scopes**.
Tick **video.list** (your views) and **user.info.stats** (your followers, for the money tile). Press **Add**.
Now these must be there: user.info.basic, video.publish, video.list, user.info.stats.
video.upload may be there too. Leave it.

ifYouSee.do: Open **Login Kit** first. The button is under its **Scopes**.

tiktok.title: Fill in App review, then Save
say: Open **App review**. Paste the text below.
Record your screen for a few seconds: the About page, then this setup page. Upload that video.
Now press **Save**. You swap in the real demo video later (step 21).

ifYouSee.do: App review needs both: the text and a video. Check both are there.

tiktok.title: Prove the website is yours
say: Open **URL properties**. Press **Verify properties** with **Production** picked.
Pick **URL prefix** (not Domain). Paste the address. Press **Verify**.
Download TikTok's file. Drop it in the box below.
Back on TikTok, press **Verify**.

tiktok.title: Paste Client key and secret
say: Open **Credentials**.
Press the copy icon next to **Client key**. Paste it below.
Do the same for **Client secret**. Press **Save keys**.

tiktok.title: Make a Sandbox for testing
say: Switch **Production** to **Sandbox**. Press **Create Sandbox**.
Give it a name. Clone Production. Press **Confirm**.
Press **Apply changes**.
Connect in the Sandbox first. Posts stay private until TikTok approves the app.

tiktok.title: Add yourself as a test user
say: Open **Sandbox settings**, then **Target users**.
Press **Add account**. Log in and accept.
It can take up to an hour. Refresh the page to check.

tiktok.title: Verify the website in Sandbox too
say: Do the Prove the website step again, with **Sandbox** picked.
Drop that file in the box below too.

tiktok.title: Use the Sandbox keys
say: Look at **Credentials** in the Sandbox.

ifYouSee.see: a different Client key in the Sandbox
ifYouSee.do: Paste those keys here for now: open the Paste step and press Change keys.

tiktok.title: Connect TikTok
say: Press **Connect TikTok**. Log in.
Check that it says Clip Factory. Leave every switch on.
Press **Authorize**.

tiktok.title: Record the real demo video
say: Record your screen while you use Clip Factory, connected in the Sandbox.
Show: open Clip Factory, press **Connect TikTok**, TikTok's **Authorize** screen.
Then press **Upload** on a clip, pick in the **Post to TikTok** sheet, and Upload.
Then show the post arriving on your TikTok.

tiktok.title: Ask TikTok to check the app
say: Switch back to **Production**. Open **App review**.
Check the text below is there. Swap in the real demo video (up to 5, 50 MB each). Press **Save**.
Press **Submit for review**. Then pick what TikTok says below.

ifYouSee.do: Read **Review comments**, fix what they say, and submit again.

tiktok.title: When it says Live
say: Look at **Credentials** in **Production**.

ifYouSee.see: Production keys that are not the Sandbox ones
ifYouSee.do: Paste them in the Paste step, then press Connect again.

tiktok.title: Ask to post publicly
say: Open TikTok's form and fill it in.
Until it passes, every post is **Only me**.
TikTok may say no to a tool only you use. Then posts stay private.

tiktok.title: Make your account public again
say: Only after TikTok says yes to the form.
In the TikTok app, turn **Private account** off.

instagram.title: Make Instagram a pro account
say: In the Instagram app, tap your picture, then the menu.
Tap **Account type and tools**, then **Switch to professional account**.
Pick **Creator** or **Business**.
Personal accounts cannot connect.

instagram.title: Link Instagram to a Facebook Page
say: In the Instagram app, tap **Edit profile**, then **Page** (under Public business information).
Pick your Facebook Page, or press **Create a Facebook Page**.
No Page yet? Make one first in the Facebook setup, step 1.

ifYouSee.do: On Facebook, open your Page, then **Settings**, then **Linked accounts**, then **Instagram**. Press **Connect account**.
If it shows your clip Instagram name, it is linked. Close it. Never press **Disconnect**. Press I did this.
Press **Disconnect**, then **Connect account** and log in to your clip Instagram.

instagram.title: Use a computer
say: The developer websites work best on a computer. Use the same browser for every step.
Log in to facebook.com with the Facebook account that will own the app.
Wrong account? Log out first.

instagram.title: Business portfolio, if Meta asks
say: Only if Meta asks for one. Press **Create a business portfolio**. Fill in a name, your name and email.
Open **Settings**, then **Accounts**, then **Instagram accounts**.
Press **Add** and log in to Instagram.
Already in a portfolio? Use that one.

instagram.title: Become a Meta developer
say: Press **Next**.
Type the codes Meta sends you.
Pick **Creator**.

instagram.title: Create the app
say: Press **Create app**. App name: paste it. Add your email. Press **Next**.
Use case: **Manage messaging & content on Instagram**. Press **Next**.
Pick your portfolio, or skip it. Press **Next**, then **Go to dashboard**.
Never ask Meta for a review.

instagram.title: Fill in Basic settings
say: Open **App settings**, then **Basic**.
Paste the **Privacy Policy URL** and the **Terms of Service URL**.
Under **User data deletion**, paste the **Data deletion instructions URL**.
Pick a **Category**. Press **Save changes**.

instagram.title: Make the Instagram login setup
say: Open **Use cases**, press **Customize** next to Instagram. Open the tab **API setup with Facebook login**.
Press **Create new configuration** (under Facebook Login for Business › Configurations). Token type: **User access token**, the longest expiry. Assets: your Page and Instagram account.
Press **Edit permissions**. Tick instagram_basic, **instagram_manage_insights**, instagram_content_publish, pages_show_list and pages_read_engagement.
Press **Use this configuration**. Paste the Redirect URL. Press **Save**.

ifYouSee.do: Tick it. It is not ticked by itself.
Leave it ticked.

instagram.title: Double-check the return address
say: Only if your app has a **Facebook Login for Business** page. No such page? Skip this.

ifYouSee.do: Paste the address into **Valid OAuth Redirect URIs**. Turn **Enforce HTTPS** on. Press **Save changes**.

instagram.title: Paste the 3 values
say: Paste the **App ID** and the **App secret** (press **Show**; Facebook may ask your password).
Paste the **Configuration ID**. The whole **Login URL** works too.
Press **Save keys**.

instagram.title: Connect Instagram
say: Press **Connect Instagram**. Log in with the same Facebook account.
Pick your portfolio if asked, then your Instagram. Confirm.
Several accounts? You pick one in Clip Factory next.

ifYouSee.see: your Instagram is not in the list
ifYouSee.do: It is still personal (step 1), not linked to a Page (step 2), or in another portfolio (step 4).

instagram.title: Post one test clip
say: Upload one clip and wait a few minutes.
Instagram can take a few minutes to post. Numbers can take 2 days.

ifYouSee.see: your Reels missing for other people
ifYouSee.do: Tell Clip Factory support. Meta may want the app Live.

ifYouSee.see: Facebook asking you to confirm who runs the Page
ifYouSee.do: Do it. Instagram will not post until you do.

facebook.title: Have a Facebook Page
say: Open your Pages. None yet? Press **Create new Page**.
Profiles cannot post Reels through apps. You need a Page.
You need **Content** or **Full control** access on the Page.
Then tap your picture and switch back to your own profile. Do not change Page settings.

ifYouSee.see: **Manage connection** after **Edit profile** on your Page
ifYouSee.do: If it shows your Instagram name, it is linked. Close it. Never press **Disconnect**. Press I did this.
Leave those choices as they are. They only matter if other people help run your Page.

facebook.title: Use a computer
say: The developer websites work best on a computer.
Use the same browser for every step.

facebook.title: Turn on Meta for developers
say: Press **Log in** or **Get Started**. Accept.
Check your phone or email with the code Meta sends.
Already done in the Instagram setup? Just press I did this.

facebook.title: Create the app
say: App name: paste it. Never put Facebook, Meta or Instagram in the name.
Add your email. Press **Next**.

facebook.title: Pick one use case
say: Tick only **Manage everything on your Page**.
Do not tick the Instagram one or **Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login**.
Use cases cannot be removed later. Press **Next**.

facebook.title: Finish the app
say: Business: pick your portfolio, or **I don't want to connect a business portfolio yet**.
Press **Next**, **Next**, then **Go to dashboard**.

facebook.title: Turn on Page permissions
say: On the **Dashboard**, press **Customize the Manage everything on your Page use case**.
Press **Add** next to pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts, read_insights and pages_manage_engagement.
pages_show_list and business_management are already there. Press **Ready to test**.

facebook.title: Fill in Basic settings
say: Open **App settings**, then **Basic**. Paste the App domain, Privacy, Terms and **Data deletion instructions URL**.
Pick a **Category**. Upload the icon below as the **App icon**.
In the EU: **Data Protection Officer** is your name and email.
Press **+ Add platform**, then **Website**. Paste the **Site URL**. Press **Save changes**.

facebook.title: Paste the return address
say: Open **Facebook Login for Business**, then **Settings**.
Set **Client OAuth login**, **Web OAuth login** and **Enforce HTTPS** to Yes. Turn Strict Mode on.
Paste the address into **Valid OAuth Redirect URIs**. Press **Check URI**.
Press **Save changes**.

ifYouSee.see: no Facebook Login for Business in the menu
ifYouSee.do: Look under **Use cases** › **Customize**, or **Add product**.

ifYouSee.see: **Deauthorize Callback URL** or **Data Deletion Request URL** boxes
ifYouSee.do: Leave them empty.

facebook.title: Make a login configuration
say: Open **Facebook Login for Business**, then **Configurations**. Press **+ Create configuration** (not a template).
Name: paste it. If asked, pick **General**. Token: **User access token**, the longest expiry.
Assets: **Pages**. Tick the 6 permissions below.
Press **Create**.

facebook.title: Paste the 3 values
say: Paste the **App ID** and the **App secret** from **App settings** › **Basic**.
Paste the **Configuration ID** from **Configurations**.
Press **Save keys**.

facebook.title: Connect Facebook
say: Press **Connect Facebook**, then **Continue**.
Tick your clip Page. Leave every switch ON. One off and Facebook gives nothing.
Press **Save**, then **Got it**.
Several Pages? You pick one in Clip Factory next.

facebook.title: Make the app Live
say: In the left menu, press **Publish**. Check the list, then press **Publish** at the bottom right.
No **Publish** in the menu? Flip the **App Mode** switch to **Live**.
Meta says info is missing? Go back to Fill in Basic settings.

ifYouSee.do: Your Reels stay visible only to you for now. Tell Clip Factory support.

x.title: Use the X account your clips go on
say: Its email must be confirmed. X may ask for a phone number.
It must not be protected, or only followers see your clips.

x.title: Use a computer
say: The developer websites work best on a computer.
Use the same browser for every step.

x.title: Ask a grown-up for a card
say: X charges a little for every post: about 1.5 cents.
Ask a grown-up to help with a normal credit or debit card.
Prepaid cards get no bonus.

x.title: Sign in to the X Developer Console
say: Open the X Developer Console with the same X account.
Accept the **Developer Agreement and Policy**.
In the use-case box, paste the text below.

x.title: Buy a few credits
say: Open **Billing**, then **Credits**. Save the card with your grown-up.
Buy the smallest amount. Set a spending limit of $10.
Leave auto-recharge OFF.
X may add $20 free after the first purchase.

x.title: Create the app
say: Open **Apps**. Press **Create App** (or **New App**).
Name: paste it (taken? add your name). Description: paste it. Press **Create**.
Clip Factory does NOT need the API Key, API Secret, Bearer Token or Access Token.
Press **Close**.

ifYouSee.see: a **Client ID** and **Client Secret** in the box
ifYouSee.do: Paste them now in the Paste step below, then press Close.

x.title: Open the sign-in settings
say: Open your app, then **Keys & Tokens**.
Next to **User authentication settings**, press **Set up** (or **Edit**).

x.title: Pick Read and write
say: App permissions: **Read and write**.
Type of App: **Web App, Automated App or Bot**.

x.title: Paste the addresses
say: Paste the **Callback URI / Redirect URL** and the **Website URL**.
If X asks, paste the Terms and Privacy links too.
Press **Save Changes**.

x.title: Paste Client ID and Secret
say: Copy the **Client ID** and the **Client Secret**. X shows them only once.
Paste them below. Press **Save keys**, then **Close** on X.

ifYouSee.do: Open **Keys & Tokens** and press **Regenerate**.

x.title: Connect X
say: Press **Connect X**.
Check it is the right account. Press **Authorize** (it may say **Authorize app**).

ifYouSee.do: Redo the Paste the addresses step with the Copy button.

x.title: Keep a few credits
say: Each post uses a few credits. Clip Factory stops at $10 a month.
Clip Factory never puts links in X posts (a link costs $0.20).
